name: [pse] Edge queue backlog on a shard
message: An engine pod is down or too slow: decisions for its sites are waiting. Runbook: docs/RUNBOOK.md#queue-backlog @pagerduty-parking-platform

name: [pse] Ingest p99 above 300 ms
message: Edge devices will buffer and resend. Runbook: docs/RUNBOOK.md#ingest-slow @slack-parking-platform

name: [pse] Scanners degraded
message: A scanner's read quality is drifting (dirty lens, misaligned camera). Open a field-service ticket. Runbook: docs/RUNBOOK.md#scanner-degraded @slack-field-service

name: [pse] Reviews waiting
message: The operator queue is growing faster than it is answered; charges and notices wait. Runbook: docs/RUNBOOK.md#review-queue @slack-parking-ops

name: [pse] Charges failing at the payment provider
message: The payment provider is failing; charges stay in the outbox and are retried with the same key. Runbook: docs/RUNBOOK.md#psp-outage @pagerduty-parking-platform
